shop-walkthrough.text: Let’s make a private lookbook for Maya, a bride at our sample shop, Juniper Bridal.
Start in the gown catalog. Vale is already selected.
Click Faye to add a second gown. Both styles now appear in Maya’s shortlist.
Choose Build lookbook to set the rules for her private link.
Set the expiry to seven days. That gives Maya a week to open her lookbook.
Maya can try every gown as often as she likes while her link is open. Your shop pays for delivered looks.
In your shop workspace, choose Send lookbook to create the private link.
Copy that link into a message to Maya so she can open the gowns you picked for her.
Choose Copy invitation and bride videos to include the private lookbook and both how-to videos in one message.
Back in the demo, choose Open bride’s view to see Maya’s side.
Select Faye to see the one-shoulder gown on Maya.
On a live link, Maya uploads a full-length photo, enters her email, and gives permission to generate her preview.
She chooses See it on you to generate her preview.
The demo supplies a sample photo. Choose See reference photo to see what she started with.
Choose Show example try-on to compare how the gown looks.
If she wants to try it in person, she chooses Request a fitting.
Back in Fitting requests, your stylist can see Maya’s inquiry and email address.
Use that address to agree on an appointment time and have her gown ready.
Try the same steps in the demo. You can reset it and start again with a different gown.

first-try-on.text: Your stylist has sent you a private gown lookbook. Here’s how to make your first virtual try-on.
Open the link in your stylist’s message. Tap a gown you want to see on yourself.
For a clear preview, ask someone to take a full-length photo. Stand alone in even light, face the camera, and keep your arms a little away from your waist.
Include your head and both feet. Check that nothing covers your outline.
Tap Choose photo and pick that picture from your phone. Check the filename. You can change it before you continue.
Enter the email address where you want your stylist to reach you.
Read the permission statement. If you agree to use your photo for this try-on, select the checkbox.
Tap See it on you. Leave the page open while your preview is being prepared.
Here’s the finished look. Use it to decide which styles you want to try in the boutique. Your stylist can check the fit and fabric with you in person.

next-dress.text: Found a gown you like? Here’s how to explore another style, ask someone for a second opinion, and arrange a fitting.
On your finished preview, tap Try another dress. This takes you back to all the gowns your stylist picked.
Tap a different gown. While this lookbook stays open, your photo and email are already filled in.
You can change the photo or keep it. Read the consent statement for this gown, check the box if you agree, then tap See it on you.
Here’s your second look. You can repeat these steps for any gown while your invitation is open.
For a second opinion, tap Share with your people. Paste the copied link into a message to someone you choose. It opens this look.
To try the gown in person, tap Request a fitting below your preview. Wait for Fitting request sent.
Your stylist can now email you to agree on a time. You can keep exploring the lookbook while you wait.
